title: Valuables Floater Declarations Schedule: Automatic Coverage Terms for New Acquisitions
content:
Newly acquired items of a class already scheduled on the Larkspur Valuables Floater receive automatic coverage on terms set by tier: a percentage of that class's scheduled total, a cap per class, and a reporting window counted from the date of acquisition.

## Automatic coverage terms by tier

| Tier | Automatic coverage, percent of the class's scheduled total | Most automatic coverage per class (USD) | Report within (calendar days after acquisition) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 25 | 10000 | 30 |
| Valuables Floater Select | 25 | 25000 | 30 |
| Valuables Floater Preferred | 25 | 50000 | 60 |
| Valuables Floater Prestige | 30 | 100000 | 60 |
| Valuables Floater Collector | 30 | 250000 | 90 |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 50 | 500000 | 90 |

## How the three figures relate

- The percentage is applied to the scheduled total of the class the new item belongs to, not to the whole schedule.
- The cap is per class: the automatic amount is never above the cap, however large the class total.
- The reporting window is in calendar days after the acquisition date.

## Hypothetical figures

| Tier | Class scheduled total (hypothetical) | Percentage share | Cap | Automatic coverage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Valuables Floater Classic | 20000 USD of jewelry | 5000 USD (25 percent) | 10000 USD | 5000 USD |
| Valuables Floater Classic | 48000 USD of jewelry | 12000 USD (25 percent) | 10000 USD | 10000 USD |
| Valuables Floater Private Client | 400000 USD of watches | 200000 USD (50 percent) | 500000 USD | 200000 USD |
